title: Re-pick an already-granted port in the chooser (the L1 mechanism)
manual: With the board connected, open the chooser again (Connect / add device) and pick the SAME port.
Watch for duplicate cards, disconnects, or a wedged session.

emulated.note: The `mark` step is load-bearing here. This spec's `expect` is `flow:connecting`, which the FIRST connect already produces — so a lane that only checked the `expect` list would pass while proving nothing about the re-pick. `await ... fresh` refuses to be satisfied by anything captured before the second pick.
